description: Hours in the warm range the source describes as favourable for early blight, with rain (leaf-wetness proxy).

citation.quote: The disease is favored by warm temperatures between 75 and 85 degrees Fahrenheit combined with periods of high humidity or leaf wetness.

interpretation_notes: 75-85 °F converted to 23.9-29.4 °C. 'High humidity' has no numeric threshold in the source so humidity is not used; leaf wetness is approximated by precipitation > 0 mm.
